name: libavoid-rust
description: Rust/WASM port of the libavoid connector-routing library (adaptagrams) with a JavaScript API

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && node scripts/prepare-pkg.cjs
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg && node scripts/prepare-pkg.cjs
scripts.test: cargo test && npm run build:node && npm run test:node
